content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Monthly consultancy fee fixed by slab of post-qualification experience (Annexure-I): factor 1.00 for National Highways Sector experience, 0.65 for other experience; inclusive of all taxes, no other allowance. Purely contractual engagement at Senior Associate level Legal status of independent consultant, not staff, official or employee of NHIDCL Fixed period of 2 years, may be extended by 1 year up to maximum 3 years (2+1) Continuation beyond first and subsequent years contingent on Consultants' Review Committee (CRC) decision Induction Module of 3 days for each hired professional Annual enhancement of 5% in consultancy fee as per approved Scheme

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for NHIDCL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 19 November 2026. Applications opened on 5 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in NHIDCL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 25 vacancies: 15 Senior Associate (Technical), 4 Senior Associate (Human Resources), 3 Senior Associate (Legal), 3 Senior Associate (Information Technology).

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for NHIDCL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply online through the link in the Important Links table, on or before 19 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 45 years (as on date of issue of Recruitment Advertisement).

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: ₹80,000 – ₹1,50,000 per month for Senior Associate (Technical), ₹80,000 – ₹1,50,000 per month for Senior Associate (Human Resources), ₹80,000 – ₹1,50,000 per month for Senior Associate (Legal), ₹80,000 – ₹1,50,000 per month for Senior Associate (Information Technology).

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Technical: Degree in Civil Engineering; HR: MBA in HR or equivalent; Legal: LLB / LLM or Graduate / Postgraduate Degree in Law; IT: B.E./B.Tech. in CS / IT / Networks / ECE or M.Tech. in Cyber Security / Network Management or MCA. All posts need 2-9 years relevant post-qualification experience and at least 2 years (730 days) in the National Highways Sector. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Essential qualification must be recognized by AICTE/UGC/State Technical Boards. Email ID must be kept active for one year; no change in email ID allowed. Engagement subject to successful background verification (BGV). Young Professionals will provide full-time services.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates without minimum 2 years (730 days) relevant post-qualification experience in the National Highways Sector.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Interview by Selection Committee. Document verification. Selection based on interviews by a Selection Committee constituted for the purpose. Interview conducted for all applicants on 26.11.2026, reporting time 09:30 a.m.

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Purely contractual engagement at Senior Associate level. Legal status of independent consultant, not staff, official or employee of NHIDCL. Fixed period of 2 years, may be extended by 1 year up to maximum 3 years (2+1).
